(require :asdf)
(asdf:initialize-output-translations '(:output-translations ("/Users/rgb/workspace/hyperdoc-dreyeck-ch/" "/var/folders/y1/yhhpj5wd7cb5325t8__1ct2r0000gn/T/hyperdoc-topic-maps-22u-z_gpmf_r/project-fasls/") ("/Users/rgb/workspace/topic-maps-normalization/" "/var/folders/y1/yhhpj5wd7cb5325t8__1ct2r0000gn/T/hyperdoc-topic-maps-22u-z_gpmf_r/project-source-fasls/") :inherit-configuration))
(asdf:initialize-source-registry
 `(:source-registry (:tree "/Users/rgb/workspace/hyperdoc-dreyeck-ch/") (:tree "/Users/rgb/workspace/topic-maps-normalization/")
   ,@(loop for entry in (uiop:split-string (uiop:getenv "CL_SOURCE_REGISTRY") :separator ":")
           when (uiop:string-prefix-p "/nix/store/" entry)
             collect `(:tree ,(uiop:ensure-directory-pathname (string-right-trim "/" entry))))
   :ignore-inherited-configuration))
(asdf:load-system "dreyeck/work/project/tests")
;; Progress around the existing fixture constructor, without changing a source,
;; result or scenario. The original function is called once, unmodified.
(let* ((symbol (find-symbol "%SCENARIO" "DREYECK/WORK/PROJECT/TESTS"))
       (original (symbol-function symbol)) (number 0))
 (unwind-protect
  (progn
   (setf (symbol-function symbol)
    (lambda (&rest args)
     (format t "~&PROJECT-SCENARIO-START ~D ~A~%" (incf number) (first args)) (finish-output)
     (multiple-value-prog1 (apply original args)
      (format t "~&PROJECT-SCENARIO-DONE ~D~%" number) (finish-output))))
   (uiop:symbol-call :dreyeck/work/project/tests :run-acceptance-tests)
   (format t "~&SEPARATE-PROJECT-ACCEPTANCE-PASS~%"))
  (setf (symbol-function symbol) original)))
scope: Remaining existing Project Workspace Acceptance phase only. Source and Readback phases already passed in project-tests.log. No source is edited; constructor wrapper only reports progress.
